project_type: Laravel 10 PHP application with Blade templates, Livewire components, TailwindCSS via CDN, AlpineJS
build_system: Laravel Mix / Vite - assets compiled but CDNs used for most libraries
test_framework: PHPUnit for backend, manual testing for frontend
test_command: Manual browser testing - navigate to key pages, test interactions
verification_instructions: 1. Clear Laravel cache with 'php artisan optimize:clear'. 2. Start dev server with 'php artisan serve'. 3. Visit pages in browser: home, dashboard (student/tutor/parent/admin), sessions, bookings. 4. Test icon display across all pages. 5. Test alert/confirm interactions (booking cancellation, file uploads, form submissions). 6. Verify SweetAlert2 toasts appear for flash messages.
environment_constraints: Production environment on Windows. Database: MySQL (tutor_platform). Never restart production services without explicit instruction. Use 'php artisan serve' for local testing only.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Standard Laravel conventions apply. Changes must be backward-compatible. Preserve existing functionality while improving UI consistency.
key_patterns: Blade layouts extend from layouts/app.blade.php (authenticated), layouts/guest.blade.php (auth pages), layouts/admin.blade.php (admin panel). Color scheme: --ink (black), --trust-blue (primary), --mint (success), --coral (danger), --gold (warning). Font Awesome 6.4.0+ already loaded via CDN. SweetAlert2 v11 already loaded. AlpineJS used for reactive UI. Existing sweetalert-config.js provides: showSuccess(), showError(), showConfirm(), showToast(), showLoading(), hideLoading(), confirmAction(), cancelBooking().
directory_structure: resources/views/ contains all Blade templates. Organized as: layouts/ (app, guest, admin), pages/ (feature pages), auth/ (authentication), components/ (reusable), emails/, partials/. public/js/ contains custom JavaScript. app/Http/Controllers/ contains Laravel controllers (not modified in this task).
